notes: Official BVAL sheet titled "BVAL Girls Soccer / 2025 - 26 Team Standings", linked from bval.org/standings. Varsity order is the sheet's own "Place".
Records only: the sheet has Overall and League Record per school and no points, goals or tiebreak data, so none are stored or computed.
Records are written as the sheet prints them (W-L-T), without the spaces around each hyphen.
The sheet prints no tied place.

The 2025-26 divisions are the sheet's (Mt. Hamilton; Santa Teresa; West Valley), not 2026-27's in lib/registry/soccer/bval.ts. Filed elsewhere in 2026-27: Christopher (Mt. Hamilton), Evergreen Valley (Mt. Hamilton), Gilroy (Santa Teresa), Willow Glen (Santa Teresa), Prospect (Santa Teresa), Oak Grove (West Valley). The registry is not changed; the page says these teams moved.
JV is not stored: the sheet has a JV Record column, but a JV place for three schools only, so there is no JV standings order to publish.
No all-league awards: this sport's BVAL all-league documents are not transcribed, so every division's awards are null.

notes: PAL girls soccer 2025-26, from pal.smcoe.org: the standings linked from https://pal.smcoe.org/standings. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.

The varsity tables are the PDF linked as "Soccer - Girls VAR" from pal.smcoe.org/standings ("2026 GIRLS VARSITY BAY SOCCER STANDINGS" and "… OCEAN …"); the JV tables are the one linked as "Soccer - Girls JV" (https://drive.google.com/file/d/11CUGRBH9_09UlWeGJM5946cM7hZjshwP/view).
Each table prints Rank, School, Win, Loss and Tie: no points and no overall record, so every overallRecord is null. Rows keep the PDF's rank, which repeats for teams ranked level (3, 3, 5).

Division membership is 2025-26's: Aragon, Burlingame, Carlmont, Hillsdale, Menlo-Atherton, Sequoia and Woodside in the Bay; Capuchino, El Camino, Half Moon Bay, Jefferson, Mills, Oceana, San Mateo, South San Francisco, Terra Nova and Westmoor in the Ocean.
The JV Ocean table ranks Half Moon Bay (4-1-0) 1st beside Terra Nova (5-0-0); it is kept as printed.
Oceana played in the PAL's Ocean in 2025-26 and is in none of this build's leagues now (the CCS places it in the PSAL for 2026-27): its rows keep its name and have no slug (`leftBuild`).
The JV Ocean table lists six teams; El Camino, Jefferson, Oceana and Westmoor are in none.
Only standings are stored: the PAL's all-league teams are not transcribed.

provenance.extraction: Standings: pdftotext -layout. All-league awards: By hand, from pdftotext -layout and pdftotext (reading order) of each PDF; each row is [player, school, position, year] as printed.
notes: SCVAL girls soccer, from scval.com/standings. Rows are in the PDF's own "SCHOOL by finish" order; nothing is recomputed, since the PDF carries no game-level data.
The PDF's "Overall record" column is empty, so every overallRecord is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 PDF's, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
School spellings are the documents' own ("Mt. View", "Monta VIsta"); `slug` is the join key.
Grades are stored as 9-12 whatever the document wrote ("Jr", "Junior", "Soph", "Frosh", "11").
An overall award is stored as "Player, School, Position, Grade" from the document's four cells. Two players named for one award are two entries under the same title.
JV membership differs from varsity: El Camino JV has 6 teams (no Saratoga, no Lynbrook).

The El Camino document names two players for Most Valuable Offensive Player (Grace Kochman of MacDonald, Sophia Yamada of Monta Vista) and one for its Co-Most Valuable Goalkeeper award (Melanie Adler of Wilcox); both are kept as printed.
The De Anza document gives Teagan Kaefer M on the award line and D on the first team; both are kept as printed.
Names are as printed, including the De Anza JV second team's single name "Stina" (Palo Alto).

provenance.extraction: Transcribed from the two pages' HTML, read 2026-11-16, leaving out the tables the standings page comments out: each row as printed, and checked against the pages row by row.
notes: WBAL girls soccer 2025-26, from hs.wbalsports.org: the standings linked from https://hs.wbalsports.org/history.html and the all-league teams linked from https://hs.wbalsports.org/history.html. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.
The standings page prints a place for the first of two teams ranked level and leaves the next row's blank; the blank row takes the place above it (1, 2, 2, 4).
The standings print a league record and no overall record, so every overallRecord is null.
The all-league page prints each player as "Player, School" with no year or position, so every year and position is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 pages' own, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
Presentation played in the WCAL in 2025-26 (`joinedSince`): no WBAL table of that season lists it.
School spellings are the pages' own ("Crystal", "Mercy"); `slug` is the join key.
Girls soccer: the page prints points, games played, a W-L-T record and a win percentage; the record is stored, the rest follows from it (three points a win, one a tie).
Only Foothill has a JV table (four teams); the page's Skyline JV table, Pinewood and Priory at 0-0-0, is commented out of its HTML and is not stored.
The all-league page lists one honorable mention as "Brooklyn Denegri Notre Dame Belmont", with no comma; it is read as the player Brooklyn Denegri of Notre Dame Belmont.
The Skyline page names Co-Defenders of the Year, two entries under one title.

provenance.extraction: Transcribed from the pdftotext -layout text of both PDFs, read 2026-11-16: each row as printed, and checked against the PDFs row by row.
notes: WCAL girls soccer 2025-26, from wcalsports.org: the standings linked from https://wcalsports.org/standings/ and the all-league teams linked from https://wcalsports.org/awardsrecords/. Rows are in the league's own order; nothing is recomputed.

The standings PDF is the WCAL's 2025-2026 archive, linked as "2025-2026" from wcalsports.org/standings/; the all-league PDF is its 2025-26 awards book, linked as "2025-2026" from wcalsports.org/awardsrecords/.
The PDF prints no place column: each table is in its own order, and `place` is the row's position in it.
Overall is the PDF's "Season" columns.
Presentation played in the WCAL in 2025-26 and is in the WBAL's Foothill division now; its rows keep its slug (`formerMembers`), and the page says it moved.
The PDF's freshman tables are not stored: the archive has varsity and JV only.

Girls soccer tables of February 18, 2026: league wins, losses, ties and points, then the season's. Points are not stored; every row's is three a win and one a tie except Archbishop Riordan's JV row, which prints 1-10-1 and 5 points.
Archbishop Riordan's varsity row prints 1-11-1, thirteen league games where every other team played twelve; it is kept as printed.
The JV table lists Sacred Heart Cathedral and Archbishop Mitty, both 7-4-1 with 22 points, in that order; with no place column, they are 3rd and 4th.

The awards are the PDF's "2026 WCAL Women's Soccer Players of the Year" (each "Player – Year – School") and its first team, second team and honorable mention (Name, School, Year, Position). The WCAL names no JV all-league team.
